# Week 23 — 2026

## 2026-06-03
Brainstormed and designed a project diary system. Decided on weekly markdown files named by ISO week (`YYYY-Www.md`) stored in `.github/diary/`. Built a `/diary` skill with two modes: `read` (load context at session start) and `log` (append a session summary). Long-term memory was discussed but deemed redundant — recurring gotchas will go in AGENTS.md instead. Next: `/diary` skill will be available from next session onward.
